title: 10 Supplements That Fight Inflammation: A Comprehensive Guide to Natural Relief - EffePharm
abstract:
Resveratrol is a potent antioxidant naturally found in grapes, berries, and red wine. It exerts significant effects on inflammatory pathways and has been investigated for its therapeutic potential in various chronic conditions, including inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), obesity, and liver disorders.  
Resveratrol’s anti-inflammatory properties have been extensively studied in both healthy individuals and those with chronic diseases\[11]\[12]\[13]. For example, a randomized controlled trial published in 2015 evaluated the effects of daily supplementation with 500 mg of resveratrol in patients with ulcerative colitis (UC), a form of IBD. After six weeks, participants receiving resveratrol showed notable improvements in disease symptoms, inflammation markers, and overall quality of life compared to the placebo group.\[12]  
In addition, a 2019 systematic review highlighted resveratrol’s potential role in metabolic health, reporting that it may enhance energy expenditure and contribute to reductions in body fat\[13]. However, the authors emphasized that its clinical efficacy is limited by poor bioavailability\[13], underscoring the need for further research and the development of improved delivery methods, such as liposomal technology.
